raw: [name="Brigid"]I trod upon the road, heading out to war♪
speaker: Brigid
content: I trod upon the road, heading out to war♪

raw: [name="Brigid"]No pipes a-singing, nor battle drums a-roar♪
speaker: Brigid
content: No pipes a-singing, nor battle drums a-roar♪

raw: [name="Brigid"]Only the bells behind me, through dew and fog their rings do soar♪
speaker: Brigid
content: Only the bells behind me, through dew and fog their rings do soar♪

speaker: Dying Resident
content: Stop singing!

raw: [name="Dying Resident"]That song snatched Niels away from me! Why would you still sing that song, nomad?!
speaker: Dying Resident
content: That song snatched Niels away from me! Why would you still sing that song, nomad?!

raw: Emma seems lost to madness, until a soft voice sings the same tune, but with different lyrics.
content: Emma seems lost to madness, until a soft voice sings the same tune, but with different lyrics.

raw: The night-blind laborer is led by a wakewoman as they slowly walk into the square.
content: The night-blind laborer is led by a wakewoman as they slowly walk into the square.

speaker: Moran
content: Again through the dark woods—♪

speaker: Dying Resident
content: I said stop singing that!

speaker: Dying Resident
content: —Wait, 'again'?

raw: [name="Moran"]It may be presumptuous, but I tried writing a new verse to the song.
speaker: Moran
content: It may be presumptuous, but I tried writing a new verse to the song.

raw: [name="Moran"]Because I don't want our brave loved ones... to just leave us, to never to see us again, to be eternally lost in the mist, just like we are.
speaker: Moran
content: Because I don't want our brave loved ones... to just leave us, to never to see us again, to be eternally lost in the mist, just like we are.

raw: Again through the dark woods—parting the mists of hoar♪
content: Again through the dark woods—parting the mists of hoar♪

raw: Our gallants dearly departed, my heart so sad and sore♪
content: Our gallants dearly departed, my heart so sad and sore♪

raw: And so in my dreams I go, lighting bonfires in the woods♪
content: And so in my dreams I go, lighting bonfires in the woods♪

raw: Not to reunite, but to light the path you trod with fog and dew♪
content: Not to reunite, but to light the path you trod with fog and dew♪

raw: [name="Dying Resident"]...Not to reunite, but to... light the path you trod...?
speaker: Dying Resident
content: ...Not to reunite, but to... light the path you trod...?

raw: A tear trickles from Emma's eyes, streaking across her sallow face.
content: A tear trickles from Emma's eyes, streaking across her sallow face.

raw: [name="Moran"]Return it... Return your flames, and the blessing of the Red Dragon.
speaker: Moran
content: Return it... Return your flames, and the blessing of the Red Dragon.

speaker: Dying Resident
content: Return the flames...?

raw: [name="Dying Resident"]If I... return this blessing... this fire back to her, will it light up their path?
speaker: Dying Resident
content: If I... return this blessing... this fire back to her, will it light up their path?

raw: [name="Moran"]Return it, and the wandering departed will also return to the flames and rest in peace.
speaker: Moran
content: Return it, and the wandering departed will also return to the flames and rest in peace.

raw: [name="Dying Resident"]No, I don't want that, I just... want to see him again...
speaker: Dying Resident
content: No, I don't want that, I just... want to see him again...

raw: [name="Moran"]If you die as you are, you will only ever brush past each other in the fog, again and again.
speaker: Moran
content: If you die as you are, you will only ever brush past each other in the fog, again and again.

speaker: Dying Resident
content: Then... what should I do?

speaker: Moran
content: Live on.

raw: [name="Moran"]He chose to walk into the mist so you wouldn't need to be lost within it as well.
speaker: Moran
content: He chose to walk into the mist so you wouldn't need to be lost within it as well.

raw: [name="Moran"]Return the fire to light his path. And then let the years pass, let life begin anew, and when your hair is white and he learns his wish was fulfilled...
speaker: Moran
content: Return the fire to light his path. And then let the years pass, let life begin anew, and when your hair is white and he learns his wish was fulfilled...

speaker: Moran
content: Only then will you meet again.

raw: The woman buries her face in her hands as she kneels on the ground, tears streaming down her fingers.
content: The woman buries her face in her hands as she kneels on the ground, tears streaming down her fingers.

raw: Moran hands her a candle. The candle flame turns purple the moment she takes it between sobs.
content: Moran hands her a candle. The candle flame turns purple the moment she takes it between sobs.

raw: The wakemen and refugees slowly sing their way through the city, like a tiny stream left behind after a night of rain.
content: The wakemen and refugees slowly sing their way through the city, like a tiny stream left behind after a night of rain.

raw: It is by no means a clear stream, nor a turbulent one. It is a miserable, muddy trickle flowing down centuries of painful history, carrying dust and blood, and about to run dry.
content: It is by no means a clear stream, nor a turbulent one. It is a miserable, muddy trickle flowing down centuries of painful history, carrying dust and blood, and about to run dry.

raw: But it is this murky bitterness that reveals the city's true self in the gloomy night.
content: But it is this murky bitterness that reveals the city's true self in the gloomy night.

raw: Nights of falling asleep gripping old photos, mornings awakened by phantom pain from amputated limbs.
content: Nights of falling asleep gripping old photos, mornings awakened by phantom pain from amputated limbs.

raw: Now-empty houses fell to ruin, while those fortunate enough to return home were greeted only by orphaned dolls scattered across dusty floors.
content: Now-empty houses fell to ruin, while those fortunate enough to return home were greeted only by orphaned dolls scattered across dusty floors.

speaker: Nemos
content: The doors... are opening?

speaker: Moran
content: They are.

raw: People flood into the streets like a burst dam, pouring into the square.
content: People flood into the streets like a burst dam, pouring into the square.

raw: Some leave their homes with candles in hand, while many more follow Emma's lead and take one from the wakewoman.
content: Some leave their homes with candles in hand, while many more follow Emma's lead and take one from the wakewoman.

raw: The flames still burn purple, but seem to have softened, and bear a bit of warmth.
content: The flames still burn purple, but seem to have softened, and bear a bit of warmth.

speaker: Nemos
content: Finally, finally...

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]Place the Red Dragon's coffin at the statue's base, Nemos.
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: Place the Red Dragon's coffin at the statue's base, Nemos.

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]It seems Na Saoirsí will witness a grand fire-returning ceremony tonight.
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: It seems Na Saoirsí will witness a grand fire-returning ceremony tonight.

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]You should be the first, Nemos.
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: You should be the first, Nemos.

raw: [name="Nemos"]Me? But this is her funeral, so... are you sure?
speaker: Nemos
content: Me? But this is her funeral, so... are you sure?

raw: [name="Solemn Wakewoman"]It is more than just hers, is it not?
speaker: Solemn Wakewoman
content: It is more than just hers, is it not?

raw: The wakewoman looks around, trying to pinpoint the shadow of a stranger.
content: The wakewoman looks around, trying to pinpoint the shadow of a stranger.

raw: But even if the ghost wasn't trying to hide from her, she has no way of hearing the long overdue words of forgiveness from his mouth.
content: But even if the ghost wasn't trying to hide from her, she has no way of hearing the long overdue words of forgiveness from his mouth.

speaker: The Exiled King
content: Now we're even, wood-brains.

raw: Nemos takes a candle from the wakewoman, and bows before the burning coffin beneath the dragon statue.
content: Nemos takes a candle from the wakewoman, and bows before the burning coffin beneath the dragon statue.

speaker: Nemos
content: ...Rest in peace.

raw: She deliberately neglects to mention the name of the departed. She places the candle before the coffin, no longer able to stop her tears from crashing into the flames.
content: She deliberately neglects to mention the name of the departed. She places the candle before the coffin, no longer able to stop her tears from crashing into the flames.

raw: Violet fire instantly rises up into the sky, spreading from the coffin to the entire statue.
content: Violet fire instantly rises up into the sky, spreading from the coffin to the entire statue.

raw: The entire sculpture is set ablaze.
content: The entire sculpture is set ablaze.

raw: The crowd place their candles down beside the statue, and return the purple flames to the one who granted them their hue.
content: The crowd place their candles down beside the statue, and return the purple flames to the one who granted them their hue.

raw: Some are silent, and some call the Red Dragon's name, but many more chant the most precious things they had lost in the war...
content: Some are silent, and some call the Red Dragon's name, but many more chant the most precious things they had lost in the war...
Tears fall like rain.

raw: The suppressed, the promised, the twisted, the incited... Tears wash away the flickering, hollow pageantry, revealing only the sorrow of lives crushed to bits.
content: The suppressed, the promised, the twisted, the incited... Tears wash away the flickering, hollow pageantry, revealing only the sorrow of lives crushed to bits.

raw: Crude, sharp, turbid, and stuck in their throats, only now does their sorrow manage to cry out.
content: Crude, sharp, turbid, and stuck in their throats, only now does their sorrow manage to cry out.

raw: The rain of tears converges into the stream of songs, pooling around the statue as the raging blaze evaporates it all, until even the citadel behind the square is engulfed in flames.
content: The rain of tears converges into the stream of songs, pooling around the statue as the raging blaze evaporates it all, until even the citadel behind the square is engulfed in flames.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]As I said, this... is my answer.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: As I said, this... is my answer.

raw: The mist does not reply, but after a long time Loughshinny hears a deep sigh.
content: The mist does not reply, but after a long time Loughshinny hears a deep sigh.

raw: [Subtitle(text="...You made this choice yourself.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
The dark mist dissipates like awakening from a dream, and Loughshinny sees real black clouds above her.
content: The dark mist dissipates like awakening from a dream, and Loughshinny sees real black clouds above her.
She heads towards the square.

raw: She goes to return fire to the dead.
content: She goes to return fire to the dead.

raw: She walks the whole way from the city gates to the square. Every living resident is gathered before the burning statue.
content: She walks the whole way from the city gates to the square. Every living resident is gathered before the burning statue.

raw: The soaring purple flames have already taken over one side of the citadel. No one is able to approach, so Loughshinny gets all the space she could want.
content: The soaring purple flames have already taken over one side of the citadel. No one is able to approach, so Loughshinny gets all the space she could want.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: ...It should work from here too.

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Eblana... May Tara never need your flames again.
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Eblana... May Tara never need your flames again.

raw: A small blossom of fire flies from Loughshinny's palm. She does not know if this conforms to funerary tradition—it is simply an act of instinct.
content: A small blossom of fire flies from Loughshinny's palm. She does not know if this conforms to funerary tradition—it is simply an act of instinct.

raw: The bright yellow flower flutters into the purple blaze. Loughshinny stands quietly, as the other fire returners have done.
content: The bright yellow flower flutters into the purple blaze. Loughshinny stands quietly, as the other fire returners have done.

raw: But the fire does not die out.
content: But the fire does not die out.

raw: The purple fire still lights up half the sky until everyone has returned their flames, though the Originium lamps on their waists remain an ice-cold violet.
content: The purple fire still lights up half the sky until everyone has returned their flames, though the Originium lamps on their waists remain an ice-cold violet.

raw: Loughshinny finally realizes that at some point the giant dragon, still aflame, has stopped right before her.
content: Loughshinny finally realizes that at some point the giant dragon, still aflame, has stopped right before her.
She meets its eyes.
Eblana's eyes.

speaker: Loughshinny
content: Still not giving up, Eblana?

raw: [name="Loughshinny"]Very well then. I'll play along with you...
speaker: Loughshinny
content: Very well then. I'll play along with you...

speaker: Loughshinny
content: One last time.

raw: Loughshinny's spear tip flares up as the giant dragon flaps its wings and charges towards her.
content: Loughshinny's spear tip flares up as the giant dragon flaps its wings and charges towards her.
